rationale: First-order generic finite FP64 selected-branch derivatives with primal comparison selectors require explicit selection. Boolean edges stop derivative ancestry; predicate-only computations retain primal checks, while real branches retain forward-domain checks. Only reference/materializing native CPU is qualified. The external-mask-only default remains unchanged.
